limitations: These labels are the command center's final choices, not upstream test verdicts or aggregate readiness.
CURRENT means selected for the stated role; NEW and GATED do not imply activation.
Host cutover/deletion, independent acceptance and organic-use observations remain the assigned owners' separate records.
RTEB private-13 means and GGUF-versus-BF16 score comparisons are derived/sibling evidence; do not label them official scores for the deployed artifact.
Trading catalog changes are handed off; fixwave-defects owns install-plan finding2.

roles.label: CURRENT
roles.scope: Shared vLLM text embedding for ai-memory and SocratiCode; query: and passage: prefixes include their trailing spaces.
roles.apply: Codex endpoint migration was reported by the CC; Claude migration/read-back is pending its window. This publication does not rerun acceptance.

NVIDIA changes weights or publishes a successor/official quant; consumer modality or serving behavior changes; another GPU tenant is requested.

roles.label: NAMED_EXCEPTION

roles.label: RETIRED

triggers: A QMD release adds configurable-prefix remote embeddings or bundles EmbeddingGemma2 support; an executed either-client semantic smoke fails; zero organic QMD use reopens the whole lane.
